items.title: Live-Temporal test flake: 'Namespace default is not found'
items.description: server-L1-routing 2026-10-16 (judge note on KEEPER-CI-CONCLUSIONS): tests/test_projector_live.py fails on CI attempt 1 with 'Namespace default is not found' against the live Temporal dev server, 3x today: test_ok_attempt (run 38849305837, sha 4e11857), test_heartbeat_timeout_is_lease_lost_and_item_failed (run 38855239133, sha 1621385), test_ok_attempt + test_check_fail_then_ok (run 38856993443, sha 5f56487). Green on rerun each time; lanes did not touch the file. Likely dev-server startup race (namespace registered after the test connects).
items.done_criteria: Root cause of 'Namespace default is not found' in tests/test_projector_live.py named with evidence (startup race or other); fix (e.g. wait until namespace default is describable before the first test) so 20 consecutive CI-equivalent runs of tests/test_projector_live.py under pytest -n 8 on the fleet-ci runner pass with 0 occurrences; no test skipped or retried to hide it.
